subject: Important Update on Your Recent Purchase
body: Dear valued customer, We wanted to inform you that there has been a delay in the shipment of the product you recently ordered. Our team is working hard to resolve this issue and expedite the delivery process. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your understanding. Please feel free to reach out to our customer support team if you have any questions or concerns. Thank you for choosing our services. Best regards, The Customer Service Team
